code: hb_blob_t *blob = hb_blob_create((const char *)data, size, HB_MEMORY_MODE_READONLY, NULL, NULL);
note: Fuzzer-controlled bytes are wrapped into a blob and become the font face input.
The face derived from the input blob is turned into a font object used by shaping and glyph queries.
The extents lookup assumes the glyph index is valid for the loaded font tables; the safety obligation is that the glyph index must stay within the glyph data mapping.
The glyph index is translated into a byte range in the glyf table before reading glyph header fields.
A glyph header is read from the computed offset; if the offset mapping is wrong, this becomes an out-of-bounds read.
